top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child is missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers were observed administering prohibited punishment. One caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm from underneath a table and another caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the arm and holding onto the child to keep the child from moving out of a chair. The same caregiver was observed grabbing on a child and pulling on the child's arms.

top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire inspection report was not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §747.4407(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations active play space was observed to have a hoe, weeder, and multiple shovels present. The operations backyard fence has multiples gaps measuring larger than 3.5 inches and less than 9 inches.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training (26 TAC §747.801(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver has still not completed the required trainings for the last training year.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no documentation of fire safety emergency drills, fire extinguisher checks, smoke detector checks, and carbon monoxide detector testing made available for review during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram- Must Be On File (26 TAC §747.5007)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no emergency evacuation and relocation diagram available for review.
